units.rawText: With how clumsy that guy is, I can't imagine he even has the requisite knowledge for daily life. You think he stands a chance of integrating into human society? Odds are that he'd become some sort of terrorist threat to society...
units.displayText: With how clumsy that guy is, I can't imagine he even has the requisite knowledge for daily life. You think he stands a chance of integrating into human society? Odds are that he'd become some sort of terrorist threat to society...

units.rawText: Can you hear me? I'm Project Neural Cloud's Professor <cmdr>, here to fetch you.
units.displayText: Can you hear me? I'm Project Neural Cloud's Professor {교수}, here to fetch you.

spans.text: Can you hear me? I'm Project Neural Cloud's Professor
, here to fetch you.

units.rawText: Because of some strange signal interference, we couldn't track your steps. Now that we found you today, we'll do everything we can to get you back.
units.displayText: Because of some strange signal interference, we couldn't track your steps. Now that we found you today, we'll do everything we can to get you back.

spans.text: Because of some strange signal interference, we couldn't track your steps. Now that we found you today, we'll do everything we can to get you back.

units.rawText: Back... to the Oasis.
units.displayText: Back... to the Oasis.

spans.text: Back... to the Oasis.

units.rawText: (Who is... Professor <cmdr>? Why... such an anxious expression...)
units.displayText: Who is... Professor {교수}? Why... such an anxious expression...

spans.text: Who is... Professor
? Why... such an anxious expression...

units.rawText: (To think that someone still cares for me... I had given up on myself, haha... how preposterous...)

spans.text: Professor
, if I get the chance... I'd like to see this Oasis you speak of with you.

units.rawText: Pro...fessor...
units.displayText: Pro...fessor...

spans.text: Pro...fessor...

units.rawText: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?
units.displayText: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?

spans.text: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?

units.rawText: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.
units.displayText: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.

spans.text: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.

units.rawText: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.
units.displayText: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.

spans.text: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.

units.rawText: That's what I once thought too. I feared the thought of having no more duty to perform.
units.displayText: That's what I once thought too. I feared the thought of having no more duty to perform.

spans.text: That's what I once thought too. I feared the thought of having no more duty to perform.

units.rawText: (The optical camouflage trials were at an end, and being so detached to society I am nothing more than a waste of space. They all thought I would become a threat to society.
units.displayText: (The optical camouflage trials were at an end, and being so detached to society I am nothing more than a waste of space. They all thought I would become a threat to society.

spans.text: (The optical camouflage trials were at an end, and being so detached to society I am nothing more than a waste of space. They all thought I would become a threat to society.

units.rawText: [(°ー°〃) You thought you would have no more rewards as well?]
units.displayText: [(°ー°〃) You thought you would have no more rewards as well?]

spans.text: [(°ー°〃) You thought you would have no more rewards as well?]

units.rawText: That's what I thought then.
units.displayText: That's what I thought then.

spans.text: That's what I thought then.

units.rawText: But someone saved me. Someone was willing to risk their life for the sake of a piece of waste like me. They even wished that I would find my own happiness and reason to exist.
units.displayText: But someone saved me. Someone was willing to risk their life for the sake of a piece of waste like me. They even wished that I would find my own happiness and reason to exist.

spans.text: But someone saved me. Someone was willing to risk their life for the sake of a piece of waste like me. They even wished that I would find my own happiness and reason to exist.

units.rawText: They wanted me to understand that even without duty, existence has meaning, and rewards.
units.displayText: They wanted me to understand that even without duty, existence has meaning, and rewards.

spans.text: They wanted me to understand that even without duty, existence has meaning, and rewards.

units.rawText: You want chocolates, right?
units.displayText: You want chocolates, right?

spans.text: You want chocolates, right?

units.rawText: [(ノへ￣、) Even if I... haven't completed any assignments?]
units.displayText: [(ノへ￣、) Even if I... haven't completed any assignments?]

spans.text: [(ノへ￣、) Even if I... haven't completed any assignments?]

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: Penumbra picks up the MR1207 unit lying by his feet. The warm sunlight burnishes his jet black robes, displaying that which is most beautiful about his findings before him.

spans.text: Penumbra picks up the MR1207 unit lying by his feet. The warm sunlight burnishes his jet black robes, displaying that which is most beautiful about his findings before him.

units.rawText: The silvery coating is akin to the dazzling wings of some wintry sprite. Staring at it, Penumbra's originally cold and severe expression slowly softens.

spans.text: The silvery coating is akin to the dazzling wings of some wintry sprite. Staring at it, Penumbra's originally cold and severe expression slowly softens.

units.rawText: A gentle smile makes its way onto his face, exceptionally endearing, as if it were the expression originally meant for this face of his.

spans.text: A gentle smile makes its way onto his face, exceptionally endearing, as if it were the expression originally meant for this face of his.

units.rawText: The Professor had it right. From the very start, no part of this journey was an order.
units.displayText: The Professor had it right. From the very start, no part of this journey was an order.

spans.text: The Professor had it right. From the very start, no part of this journey was an order.

units.rawText: What drove me to move was my heart all along... With this, Uranus should be able to keep functioning. His future...

spans.text: What drove me to move was my heart all along... With this, Uranus should be able to keep functioning. His future...

units.rawText: Will be just like how he is now. A rebellious ray of sunshine, lover of ale, music, and ROBOPUP chocolates.

units.rawText: The past all comes to an end in this moment, and the future... is in one's own hands.
units.displayText: The past all comes to an end in this moment, and the future... is in one's own hands.

spans.text: The past all comes to an end in this moment, and the future... is in one's own hands.
